scope: Thirty serial repetitions of eight fixed synthetic receipt scenarios through native IRIS AI Hub build 109 and real Nemotron calls. No model or runtime retuning during the run. Fresh receipt timestamps per case. Final deterministic disposition and raw reviewer accuracy are distinct measurements.

plan.policy: Frozen runtime and model prompts. All cases retained, no retries or adaptive tuning. Fresh synthetic receipt timestamp per case. Unique round IDs. Existing eight scenario oracles unchanged. Native exports per round. Raw reviewer accuracy scored separately from final dispositions. Abort only on incomplete native execution or evidence export, retaining partial evidence.
